items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: All three ACs and the brief's Done-when covered by tests (real root files byte diff, named refusals, five-format release sync on a scratch git project).

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Every failure is a ManifestSyncError with a closed-vocabulary status; the re-parse equality check refuses any edit that is not exactly the version change before a byte is written.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: Reads repo-local files through the existing resolve_contained_path; no subprocess, no shell, regex built with re.escape on a validated semver.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Tests assert exact changed lines and bytes, each refusal status, and the stale verify-commit path; they fail on the pre-change code (unsupported_format).

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: Linear line scans and two tomllib parses per manifest, once per release.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: New module next to manifest_sync_lock/marketplace, 159 lines, core stays a dispatcher.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Producer sync_release_manifests -> consumers uv (uv lock --check accepts the bumped pair, rejects a stale lock) and --verify-commit (real round trip in the scratch-project test).
